title: Safe AI-Assisted Software Release with Behavioral Programming
shortDescription: Integrate an AI defect-risk recommendation into a pull-request workflow, then constrain unsafe release decisions using independent behavioral guardrails.
learningOutcomes: Explain the difference between an AI prediction and an enforceable software-engineering requirement.
Apply Behavioral Programming to integrate AI recommendations with independent release guardrails.
Implement deterministic constraints for failed tests, security findings, confidence, and coverage without modifying the AI model.
Verify that an AI-enabled software workflow satisfies explicit release requirements across multiple pull-request scenarios.
Critically evaluate when AI recommendations require deterministic controls or human review.

tasks.title: Inspect an AI-only release decision
tasks.description: Run the supplied defect-risk model and observe how an AI recommendation can conflict with current CI or security evidence.

tasks.title: Implement the release guardrail
tasks.description: Complete an independent behavioral policy that can block deployment or require human review.

tasks.title: Compare release scenarios
tasks.description: Evaluate safe, failed-test, security, low-confidence, and high-risk pull-request cases.

tasks.title: Verify requirements
tasks.description: Run executable checks over the combined AI and software-policy workflow.

tasks.title: Interpret and report
tasks.description: Document evidence and explain why AI decisions require explicit software-engineering controls.
